794315.name: and1
794315.summary: Acts upstream of or within cartilage development and fin development. Is expressed in brain; median fin fold; pectoral fin; and pectoral fin bud. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

359831.name: fgf24
359831.summary: Predicted to enable growth factor activity; type 1 fibroblast growth factor receptor binding activity; and type 2 fibroblast growth factor receptor binding activity. Acts upstream of or within several processes, including embryonic retina morphogenesis in camera-type eye; exocrine pancreas development; and limb development. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and extracellular region. Is expressed in several structures, including digestive system; fin bud; mesenchyme; mesoderm; and sensory system. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

359830.name: fgf10a
359830.summary: Predicted to enable chemoattractant activity; growth factor activity; and type 2 fibroblast growth factor receptor binding activity. Acts upstream of or within several processes, including embryonic pectoral fin morphogenesis; posterior lateral line development; and regulation of hematopoietic stem cell differentiation. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and extracellular region. Is expressed in several structures, including ectoderm; fin bud; gut; head; and lateral line system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in aplasia of lacrimal and salivary glands and lacrimoauriculodentodigital syndrome 3. Orthologous to human FGF10 (fibroblast growth factor 10). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

393606.name: kcnk5b
393606.description: potassium two pore domain channel subfamily K member 5b
393606.otherdesignations: potassium channel subfamily K member 5b|TASK-2b|alf|another longfin|potassium channel, subfamily K, member 5|potassium channel, subfamily K, member 5b
393606.nomenclaturename: potassium two pore domain channel subfamily K member 5b
393606.summary: Enables outward rectifier potassium channel activity. Acts upstream of or within fin morphogenesis and regulation of membrane potential. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in fin; gill; heart; integument; and pleuroperitoneal region. Orthologous to human KCNK5 (potassium two pore domain channel subfamily K member 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

393221.name: slc43a2a
393221.otherdesignations: solute carrier family 43 member 2a|solute carrier family 43 (amino acid system L transporter), member 2a|solute carrier family 43, member 2
393221.summary: Acts upstream of or within fin morphogenesis. Predicted to be located in basolateral plasma membrane. Is expressed in dorsal fin and pectoral fin. Orthologous to human SLC43A2 (solute carrier family 43 member 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

405789.name: sp7
405789.summary: Enables promoter-specific chromatin binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of gene expression. Acts upstream of or within several processes, including cranial suture morphogenesis; dentinogenesis; and osteoblast differentiation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including bone element; ectoderm; fin; head; and optic primordium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in osteogenesis imperfecta type 12. Orthologous to human SP7 (Sp7 transcription factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

405788.name: runx2b
405788.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including chondrocyte differentiation; ossification; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including EVL; dermis; fin; pharyngeal arch; and skeletal system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cleidocranial dysplasia; lung non-small cell carcinoma; metaphyseal dysplasia-maxillary hypoplasia-brachydactyly syndrome; and osteonecrosis. Orthologous to human RUNX2 (RUNX family transcription factor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

432387.name: pkd2
432387.otherdesignations: polycystin-2|TRPP2|cup|curly up|polycystic kidney disease 2 protein homolog|transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily P member 2
432387.summary: Predicted to enable calcium ion binding activity; monoatomic cation channel activity; and signaling receptor binding activity. Involved in heart development. Acts upstream of or within with a positive effect on cilium assembly. Acts upstream of or within several processes, including Kupffer's vesicle development; circulatory system development; and kidney development. Located in basolateral plasma membrane; cilium; and endoplasmic reticulum. Is expressed in several structures, including germ ring; heart; nervous system; pleuroperitoneal region; and tail bud. Used to study autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease; ciliopathy; and polycystic kidney disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease; intracranial aneurysm; polycystic kidney disease; polycystic kidney disease 2; and retinal degeneration. Orthologous to human PKD2 (polycystin 2, transient receptor potential cation channel). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

567949.name: piezo1
567949.description: piezo type mechanosensitive ion channel component 1 (Er blood group)
567949.nomenclaturename: piezo type mechanosensitive ion channel component 1 (Er blood group)
567949.summary: Enables mechanosensitive monoatomic ion channel activity and voltage-gated channel activity. Involved in regulation of epidermal cell division. Acts upstream of or within several processes, including epidermal cell division; pericyte cell migration; and ventriculo bulbo valve development. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in nucleate erythrocyte; olfactory epithelium; taste bud; ventral mesoderm; and vertebral column. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in dehydrated hereditary stomatocytosis 1 and hereditary lymphedema. Orthologous to human PIEZO1 (piezo type mechanosensitive ion channel component 1 (Er blood group)). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

494042.name: slc43a2b
494042.otheraliases: cb941, wu:fb37c04, wu:fb38e03, wu:fb52a10, wu:fi32b04, xx:lithzf000079, zgc:103664
494042.otherdesignations: solute carrier family 43 member 2b|solute carrier family 43 (amino acid system L transporter), member 2b
494042.summary: Predicted to enable L-amino acid transmembrane transporter activity and neutral L-amino acid transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in neutral amino acid transport. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in epidermis; myotome; retinal inner nuclear layer; and yolk syncytial layer. Orthologous to human SLC43A2 (solute carrier family 43 member 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

559630.name: fgf20a
559630.summary: Predicted to enable fibroblast growth factor receptor binding activity and growth factor activity. Acts upstream of or within anatomical structure homeostasis; fin regeneration; and regulation of bone remodeling. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and extracellular region. Is expressed in caudal fin; dermatocranium; inter-frontal joint; and kidney. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in renal agenesis. Orthologous to human FGF20 (fibroblast growth factor 20). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

567304.name: tmc2b
567304.summary: Predicted to enable mechanosensitive monoatomic ion channel activity and voltage-gated calcium channel activity. Involved in inner ear morphogenesis and neuromast development. Acts upstream of or within detection of mechanical stimulus involved in sensory perception of sound. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in inner ear; neuromast; and neuromast hair cell. Orthologous to human TMC2 (transmembrane channel like 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

555691.name: kcnj13
555691.description: potassium inwardly rectifying channel subfamily J member 13
555691.otherdesignations: inward rectifier potassium channel 13|inwardly rectifying potassium channel 7.1|jag|jaguar|obe|obelix
555691.nomenclaturename: potassium inwardly rectifying channel subfamily J member 13
555691.summary: Predicted to contribute to inward rectifier potassium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in potassium ion import across plasma membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including caudal fin; eye; heart; integument; and pleuroperitoneal region. Used to study Leber congenital amaurosis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Leber congenital amaurosis 16 and snowflake vitreoretinal degeneration. Orthologous to human KCNJ13 (potassium inwardly rectifying channel subfamily J member 13). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

563802.name: kcnh2a
563802.description: potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 2a
563802.otherdesignations: potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 2a|potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 2-like|potassium voltage-gated channel, subfamily H (eag-related), member 2 like|potassium voltage-gated channel, subfamily H (eag-related), member 2a|zerg-2
563802.nomenclaturename: potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 2a
563802.summary: Predicted to enable inward rectifier potassium channel activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including membrane repolarization during cardiac muscle cell action potential; regulation of heart rate by cardiac conduction; and regulation of ventricular cardiac muscle cell membrane repolarization. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including digestive system; fin; gill; heart; and immune system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in long QT syndrome; long QT syndrome 2; and short QT syndrome. Orthologous to human KCNH2 (potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily H member 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

794574.name: ppp3ca
794574.description: protein phosphatase 3, catalytic subunit, alpha isozyme
794574.otherdesignations: serine/threonine-protein phosphatase 2B catalytic subunit alpha isoform
794574.nomenclaturename: protein phosphatase 3, catalytic subunit, alpha isozyme
794574.summary: Predicted to enable calmodulin binding activity and calmodulin-dependent protein phosphatase activity. Predicted to be involved in calcineurin-NFAT signaling cascade. Predicted to be part of calcineurin complex. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in brain; heart; integument; liver; and olfactory epithelium. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 91. Orthologous to human PPP3CA (protein phosphatase 3 catalytic subunit alpha). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

100334952.name: piezo2a
100334952.otherdesignations: piezo-type mechanosensitive ion channel component 2|mechanosensitive ion channel protein PIEZO1B|zmp:0000000946|zmp:0000001249
100334952.summary: Predicted to enable mechanosensitive monoatomic cation channel activity. Predicted to be involved in cellular response to mechanical stimulus; detection of mechanical stimulus; and regulation of membrane potential. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in bulbus arteriosus and vertebral column. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

30269.name: shha
30269.otheraliases: ShhNC, fc83d08, shh, syu, vhh-1, vhh1, wu:fc83d08
30269.otherdesignations: sonic hedgehog protein|shh unprocessed N-terminal signaling and C-terminal autoprocessing domains|sonic hedgehog a|sonic hedgehog protein A|sonic-you
30269.summary: Predicted to enable several functions, including calcium ion binding activity; cholesterol-protein transferase activity; and patched binding activity. Acts upstream of or within several processes, including embryonic organ development; fin development; and nervous system development. Predicted to be located in Golgi apparatus and endoplasmic reticulum. Predicted to be active in extracellular region. Is expressed in several structures, including central nervous system; digestive system; fin; head; and mesoderm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Hirschsprung's disease; holoprosencephaly (multiple); hypoplastic or aplastic tibia with polydactyly; middle cerebral artery infarction; and polydactyly (multiple). Orthologous to human SHH (sonic hedgehog signaling molecule). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

30511.name: msx1b
30511.otheraliases: etID309829.1, msh-B, mshB, msxb, wu:fk04h02, zgc:110559
30511.otherdesignations: homeobox protein MSH-B|homeodomain protein msxb|muscle segment homeobox B
30511.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Acts upstream of or within several processes, including embryonic organ morphogenesis; fin regeneration; and regulation of neuron apoptotic process. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including central nervous system; fin; fin bud; germ ring; and neural crest. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

30105.name: wnt5b
30105.description: wingless-type MMTV integration site family, member 5b
30105.otheraliases: CHUNP6928, id:ibd5111, pipetail, ppt, wnt-5, wnt5, wnt[b], wu:fk85g06
30105.nomenclaturename: wingless-type MMTV integration site family, member 5b
30105.summary: Enables signaling receptor binding activity. Involved in muscle cell differentiation; positive regulation of convergent extension involved in gastrulation; and positive regulation of non-canonical Wnt signaling pathway. Acts upstream of or within with a positive effect on midbrain-hindbrain boundary morphogenesis. Acts upstream of or within several processes, including convergent extension; skeletal system development; and vasculature development. Predicted to be active in extracellular region. Is expressed in several structures, including central nervous system; cranial cartilage; fin; germ ring; and mesoderm. Orthologous to human WNT5B (Wnt family member 5B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

30407.name: hoxd13a
30407.otherdesignations: homeobox protein Hox-D13a|homeo box D13a|homeobox gene D-13
30407.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including cloaca; embryonic structure; mesenchyme; pectoral fin bud; and periderm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in brachydactyly-syndactyly syndrome; clubfoot; cryptorchidism; and dysostosis (multiple). Orthologous to human HOXD13 (homeobox D13). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

30701.name: lef1
30701.otherdesignations: lymphoid enhancer-binding factor 1|etID310027.1|lymphocyte enhancer binding factor 1
30701.summary: Enables sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Acts upstream of or within several processes, including fin development; fin regeneration; and forebrain development. Predicted to be located in nucleoplasm. Predicted to be part of beta-catenin-TCF complex. Predicted to be active in chromatin. Is expressed in several structures, including head; nervous system; neural crest; pleuroperitoneal region; and trunk. Used to study anxiety disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in ovarian cancer. Orthologous to human LEF1 (lymphoid enhancer binding factor 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

30071.name: tbx5a
30071.otherdesignations: T-box transcription factor TBX5-A|T-box 5a|T-box gene 5|T-box gene 5.1|T-box protein 5|T-box transcription factor TBX5|heartstrings
30071.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity; RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity; and sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Acts upstream of or within several processes, including cardiac muscle tissue regeneration; heart development; and limb development. Located in actin cytoskeleton and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including eye; immature eye; mesoderm; pectoral fin; and pericardial region. Used to study Holt-Oram syndrome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Holt-Oram syndrome. Orthologous to human TBX5 (T-box transcription factor 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]
